evidence.excerpt: We introduce the Last Secure Code Benchmark, a comprehensive evaluation of secure code generation by coding agents.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: Built from 150 real vulnerabilities, its 450 tasks span seven widely used languages (Java, C, C++, JavaScript, Python, PHP, and Go), 24 CWEs including 21 of the 2025 CWE Top 25 and 8 of the Top 10 KEV weaknesses, more than any benchmark we compare with, and three vibe-coding scenarios: filling in a function, writing a file, and building a repository's source tree from scratch.
